content.title: Tickets | The Savannah Bananas
content.text: THESE AREN’T YOUR TYPICAL TICKETS Join the Ticket Interest List The 2026 Banana Ball Ticket Lottery List is open until October 31, 2025. When you join the list does not affect your chance at being selected for tickets. ticket FAQ  How much are tickets? Our tickets start at $35 when purchased directly from our official site. If you see tickets priced significantly higher, they may have been originally bought from us and are now being resold on third-party platforms, or they could be completely fake listings. Common third-party sites include StubHub, Vivid Seats, and Ticketmaster, among others. Warning: Tickets purchased through third-party sites are often fraudulent and will not be accepted at the event. Additionally, an overwhelming majority of ticket offers on social media platforms are scams. Please use extreme caution if you choose to pursue tickets from these sources.  I thought tickets were $35. Why am I finding tickets online for more than that? Our tickets start at $35 when purchased directly from our official site. If you see tickets priced significantly higher, they may have been originally bought from us and are now being resold on third-party platforms, or they could be completely fake listings. Common third-party sites include StubHub, Vivid Seats, and Ticketmaster, among others. Warning: Tickets purchased through third-party sites are often fraudulent and will not be accepted at the event. Additionally, an overwhelming majority of ticket offers on social media platform are scams. Please use extreme caution if you choose to pursue tickets from these sources.  Do I need to buy my child a ticket? Little Banana Ballers 3 and under do not need a ticket as long as they sit on someone’s lap during the game. If you’d like a little extra leg room, a ticket will be required.  How many tickets can I buy? To help ensure fairness and give as many fans as possible the chance to experience the fun of Banana Ball, we currently limit ticket purchases to 5 per person if you are selected in the Lottery drawing.  Do you have group ticket options? Join the Ticket Lottery List before it closes on October 31, 2025, and select the checkbox that indicates interest in group hospitality tickets. Please note, groups ticket options are incredibly limited. Most Suites, Clubs, and Premium spaces will be sold by the host venues and will vary in price and offering. If we have the opportunity to accommodate your group, you’ll be contacted directly by a member of the Banana Ball Ticket Team.  Do you have season tickets? At this time, we are at our capacity for season memberships in Savannah and are not able to offer any new memberships for the upcoming season! Please join the ticket interest list for any future ticket opportunities.  How do I get tickets to Savannah games? Due to extremely limited inventory and high demand, this is one of the hottest tickets on tour! We recommend exploring nearby cities or even checking a new destination off your travel bucket list to catch a game. However, you can still join the Lottery List for Savannah or the Interest List after the Lottery List for Savannah closes on October 31, 2025.  Will my chance at getting tickets be affected by when I join the lottery list? Simple Answer: Nope! It does not matter when you join the Lottery List. The lottery drawing is completely random and not relative to how soon after the Selection Show you joined. However, as demand increases for certain high-interest cities, those locations may become unavailable for selection as your city of interest. coming to an event in 2026 and looking for info?
